caption: This is a pencil drawing on paper showing a single sugar bowl. The sugar bowl has a rounded body, a short stem, and a square base. It is decorated with an oval or shield-shaped engraving that contains the letters "MC" in a script font on the front of the bowl. The bowl’s rim and the edge of the base are also defined with a line to show texture or beading. Above the drawing, the label “SUGAR BOWL” is written in uppercase letters. Below the drawing, the text “Height 6 inches” is written in cursive. The drawing is bordered by uneven, rust-colored stains or marks along the edges of the page. At the bottom left, the text “CASE NO 2 13519-32” appears, and at the bottom right, the name “ALFRED NASON.” is printed. The background is an off-white, aged-looking paper.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
